refusal.outOfRange: The range for {param} is {min}"–{max}"; {value}" is outside it.
refusal.offStep: In {step}" steps from {min}", {param} cannot be {value}" — that falls between {below}" and {above}".
refusal.oneLegBoth: The {leg} leg cannot take both the sink and the refrigerator: a leg stops at {maxIn}", and those two plus the range need more than that.
refusal.islandLong: A {islandIn}" island will not fit: with a {aisleIn}" aisle off the left run there is {roomIn}" of room across a {wallIn}" wall.
refusal.islandDeep: The back run, a {aisleIn}" aisle and a {islandIn}" island come to {needIn}", which is more than the {wallIn}" the room is deep.
refusal.wallShort: At {wallIn}", {param} is {shortIn}" short of what has to go on it. The shortest that works is {minimumIn}".
suggestion.moveSink: Put the sink on the {leg} leg.
suggestion.moveSinkMinimum: Move the sink to the {leg} leg and {param}'s minimum becomes {minimumIn}".
refusal.wallLong: A single run stops at {maximumIn}", so {param} cannot be {wallIn}" — that is {overIn}" of wall with nowhere to put it.
suggestion.corner: Change the corner to {corner} and {param}'s minimum becomes {minimumIn}".
suggestion.island: Put the island back — it takes the microwave and the wine cabinet off the wall — and {param}'s minimum becomes {minimumIn}".
